title: Hold Exposure
summary: A risk service totals the authorisation holds on each account. Fix a wrong total, add peak and limit-breach queries, then make them fast for very busy books.
followUps: Why did the original code compile without a warning even though it lost data?
Two holds touch: one ends at minute 10 and the next starts at minute 10. Walk through how your code avoids counting both.
What is the cost of peak for an account with n holds, and of peakByAccount for the whole book?
Holds arrive and are released while risk queries run. What would you change to make HoldBook safe under concurrent use?
What did the assistant get wrong or leave out, and how did you notice?
